name: com.parousya.android.sdk.PRSIntentService
description: When Parousya starts this background Service, it checks the client sign-in state, restores the Automatic Check-In session, and starts pairing with nearby beacons. It runs with a notification while this background work is active.
disableEffect: Parousya's background session and beacon-pairing work will stop, disabling automatic check-ins and proximity-based session updates.
